record.question: Who won the Seoul Peace Prize for 2018?
record.explanation: Answer A: Narendra Modi. The 2018 Seoul Peace Prize was awarded to Narendra Modi. The Prime Minister’s Office’s original 24 October 2018 announcement names him as the fourteenth recipient and distinguishes the award decision from a ceremony to be arranged later. Historical/source note: 2018 award edition; announcement and later presentation date must be distinguished. No need to endorse the award citation’s political/economic assessments to establish recipient identity. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1550412&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
